metadata.explanation: Task requires cloning the huggingface/transformers repository to /home/user. Evaluator checks if the directory exists and contains a valid .git subdirectory, confirming successful clone operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks if any git repository exists at /home/user/transformers, but does not verify the repository URL
Instruction specifies cloning from 'https://github.com/huggingface/transformers', but evaluator cannot distinguish if the correct repository was cloned vs any other repository
If a user clones a different repository to the same path (e.g., https://github.com/wrong-user/transformers), the evaluator would incorrectly pass
Getter logic is correct for checking directory and .git existence, but incomplete for verifying the specific clone requirement
Metric logic correctly validates the getter output, but the getter itself does not extract enough information to verify the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add git remote URL verification to the getter: use 'git remote get-url origin' to extract the repository URL
Update expected values to include the repository URL: {'exists': true, 'is_git_repo': true, 'remote_url': 'https://github.com/huggingface/transformers'}
Update metric to compare the remote URL against the expected URL, allowing for common variations (http vs https, trailing .git, etc.)
Consider normalizing URLs for comparison (e.g., strip trailing slashes, .git extensions, convert http to https)
